m=math pi2=m.pi*2 sin=m.sin cos=m.cos atan=m.atan

-- oB(1,(angle-CeaseMin)%1>=(CeaseMax-CeaseMin)) end
function trans(x,y,z,ex,ey,ez) local xs,xc,ys,yc,zs,zc=sin(ex),cos(ex),sin(ey),cos(ey),sin(ez),cos(ez) x,y,z=x,y*xc-z*xs,z*xc+y*xs x,y,z=x*yc+z*ys,y,z*yc-x*ys x,y,z=x*zc-y*zs,y*zc+x*zs,z return x,y,z end function itrans(x,y,z,ex,ey,ez) local xs,xc,ys,yc,zs,zc=sin(ex),cos(ex),sin(ey),cos(ey),sin(ez),cos(ez) x,y,z=x*zc+y*zs,y*zc-x*zs,z x,y,z=x*yc-z*ys,y,z*yc+x*ys x,y,z=x,y*xc+z*xs,z*xc-y*xs return x,y,z end

YMAX=pn("YAW MAX") YMIN=pn("YAW MIN") EMAX=pn("ELV MAX") EMIN=pn("ELV MIN") type=pn('Weapon Type')//1|0
PID={} PID.new=function(P,I,D) local o={} o.P,o.I,o.D,o.integral,o.delta,o.active=P,I,D,0,0,false o.state=function(self,state) self.active=state end o.update=function(self,err,dt) dt=1/60 if self.active then self.integral=self.integral+(self.delta+err)/2*dt end local p=P*err local i=I*self.integral local d=D*(err-self.delta)/dt self.delta=err return p+i+d end return o end
PGain=property.getNumber('P Gain') IGain=property.getNumber('I Gain') DGain=property.getNumber('D Gain')
YawPID=PID.new(PGain,IGain,DGain)
params={ {1600,0.025,120,39.5}, {1000,0.02,150,49.5}, {1000,0.01,300,99.5}, {900,0.005,600,199.5}, {800,0.002,1500,499.5}, {700,0.001,2400,999.5}, {600,0.0005,2400,1999.5}, } type=type<1 and 1 or type>#params and #params or type vel=params[type][1] drag=params[type][2]*60 lifeSpan=params[type][3]/60 C=params[type][4] R=1-drag/60 g=30 error=0.1 Er,cc,dcc=0.15,0,-0.2 Timer=0 B={} function onTick() int=string.unpack("I4",string.pack("f",gn(32))) for i=0,31 do B[1+i]=(int&(1<<i))>0 end
tgtfound=(gn(1)~=0) MASTER=B[3] SEAT=B[4] MANTRI=B[5] SAFETY=B[6]
TGX=gn(1) TGY=gn(3) TGZ=gn(2) vX=gn(4)/60 vY=gn(6)/60 vZ=gn(5)/60
aX,aY,aZ=gn(7)/60,gn(9)/60,gn(8)/60 GunX=gn(16) GunY=gn(17) GunZ=gn(18) dx=gn(19) dy=gn(20) dz=gn(21) GPIn=gn(22) GYIn=gn(23) EX=gn(24)--X EY=gn(25)--Z EZ=gn(26)--Y
V=D3(vX,vY,vZ)*60
RotP=gn(27)/60 LookX=gn(28) LookY=gn(29)
psP=gn(30) psY=gn(31)
delay=delayremote GYOut,GPOut=0,0.01/2 Sready,Aready,inrange,Trigger=false,false,false,false DD=0 Stab=false
local gunElv,time,dist,t1
if MASTER and SEAT then Trigger=MANTRI GYOut,GPOut=LookX,LookY Stab=true elseif tgtfound and MASTER then
TGRX,TGRY,TGRZ=TGX-GunX+(vX-dx)*delay,TGY-GunY+(vY-dy)*delay,TGZ-GunZ+(vZ-dz)*delay DD=D3(TGRX,TGRY,TGRZ) RelVel=Dot3(TGRX/DD,TGRY/DD,TGRZ/DD,vX,vY,vZ) sn(30,DD/(vel/60+RelVel))
-- c no syokichi ha chanto settei suruto yoi yo -- soushinaito shatei gai dato omoi komu kara -- dekireba DD/(vel + soutai sokudo) dato yoi ne local time,c=0,(DD/(vel/60+RelVel))*1.5 if c~=c then c=0 end ddx,ddy,ddz,wx,wy=dx,dy,dz,0,0 winX,winY=0,0
-- koko no double loop ha jitsu ha sake rareru for i=1,20 do local CC=(R^c)/m.log(R)+C if CC~=CC then CC=0 end ddx,ddy,ddz,wx,wy=dx*CC,dy*CC,dz*CC,winX*(c-CC),winY*(c-CC)
ETGX=TGRX+vX*c+(aX^2)/2*c-ddx+wx ETGY=TGRY+vY*c+(aY^2)/2*c-ddy+wy ETGZ=TGRZ+vZ*c+(aZ^2)/2*c-ddz dist=(ETGX^2+ETGY^2+ETGZ^2)^0.5 elv=atan(ETGZ/(ETGX^2+ETGY^2)^0.5)
gunElv,t1,inrange=calc(dist,elv)
if inrange then time=t1*60 end c=time
end
sn(31,time)
if inrange then ETGZ=tan(gunElv)*(ETGX^2+ETGY^2)^0.5 end
rr=AT(Er,dist)/pi2 rrx,rry=rr*cos(cc*pi2),rr*sin(cc*pi2) cc=cc+dcc
if MASTER then GYOut,GPOut=GtoDir(ETGX+GunX,ETGY+GunY,m.max(ETGZ+GunZ,-10)) GYOut,GPOut=GYOut+rrx,GPOut+rry end
GYOut=GYOut/pi2 GPOut=GPOut/pi2-RotP*5
if inrange and Timer>CalcTime then Sready=true end if Sready then Trigger=true end
Stab=true Timer=Timer+1 else Timer=0 end if inrange and DD<500 then sb(3,true) else sb(3,false) end local lim,A,B,C,D=GYOut-GYIn,false,false,false,false
lim=m.max(lim^2*100,0.02) GYOut,A=clamp(GYOut,YMIN,YMAX) GYOut2=CLMP((GYOut-GYIn)*100,2) GYOut=clamp(GYOut,GYIn-lim,GYIn+lim)
psY,C=clamp(psY,YMIN,YMAX)
YawPID:state(tgtfound and Trigger) if tgtfound and Trigger then GYOut2=YawPID:update((GYOut-GYIn), 1/60) end
GPOut,B=clamp(GPOut,EMIN,EMAX)
psP,D=clamp(psP,EMIN,EMAX) tri=true if abs(GYOut)>0.40 then GPOut,tri=clamp(GPOut,0.25/3,EMAX) elseif abs(GYOut)>0.45 then GPOut,tri=clamp(GPOut,2/3/4,EMAX) end
-- koko ha Tritter=A and B and tri de yoi desu ne if C==false or D==false or tri==false then Trigger=false end
sb(1,Trigger and SAFETY) sb(2,Stab) sn(1,GYOut2) sn(2,GYIn) sn(3,GPOut*4) sn(4,GPIn) sn(5,RotY or 0) sn(6,RotP) -- Debug-only numeric channels 7..20 feed vehicle tooltips. sn(7,MASTER and 1 or 0) sn(8,SEAT and 1 or 0) sn(9,SAFETY and 1 or 0) sn(10,Trigger and 1 or 0) sn(11,(Trigger and SAFETY) and 1 or 0) sn(12,tgtfound and 1 or 0) sn(13,inrange and 1 or 0) sn(14,(tgtfound and DD) or 0) sn(15,TGX) sn(16,TGZ) sn(17,TGY) sn(18,vX*60) sn(19,vZ*60) sn(20,vY*60)
end
function onDraw() if DBGCIWS>0 then screen.setColor(255,255,255) sdt(0,0,"MA "..(MASTER and 1 or 0).." SE "..(SEAT and 1 or 0).." SA "..(SAFETY and 1 or 0).." TR "..(Trigger and 1 or 0)) sdt(0,10,"TGX "..((TGX or 0)//1).." D "..((DD or 0)//1).." INR "..(inrange and 1 or 0)) sdt(0,20,"VX "..((vX or 0)*60//1).." VZ "..((vZ or 0)*60//1).." VY "..((vY or 0)*60//1)) end end
function GtoDir(x,y,z) x,y,z=x-GunX,y-GunY,z-GunZ x,y,z=rotZ(x,y,z,-EZ) x,y,z=rotY(x,y,z,-EY) x,y,z=rotX(x,y,z,-EX) x,y,z=x,y,z-0.25 yaw,pitch=AT(x,y),AT(z/(x^2+y^2)^0.5) return yaw,pitch end function rotX(x,y,z,EX) x,y,z=x,y*cos(-EX)-z*sin(-EX),y*sin(-EX)+z*cos(-EX) return x,y,z end function rotY(x,y,z,EY) x,y,z=x*cos(-EY)-y*sin(-EY),x*sin(-EY)+y*cos(-EY),z return x,y,z end function rotZ(x,y,z,EZ) x,y,z=x*cos(EZ)-z*sin(EZ),y,x*sin(EZ)+z*cos(EZ) return x,y,z end function D3(x,y,z) return (x*x+y*y+z*z)^0.5 end function Dot3(x,y,z,a,b,c) return x*a+y*b+z*c end function getY(v,t) return -g*t/drag+(g/drag+v)*(1-m.exp(-drag*t))/drag end function getTime(v,x) return -m.log(1-drag*x/v)/drag end function calc(D,E) local t,a,w,h=0,E,D*cos(E),D*sin(E) for i=1,10 do local vx,vy=vel*cos(a),vel*sin(a) t=getTime(vx,w) if t>lifeSpan then a=E return a,t,false end y=getY(vy,t) if y>=h-error then return a,t,true end
a=a+E-atan(y,w) end a=E return a,t,false end function clamp(a,mn,mx) tf=false if a>=mn and a<=mx then tf=true end return m.min(m.max(a,mn),mx),tf end function CLMP(a,b) return m.min(m.max(a,-b),b) end

function GtoDir(x,y,z) x,y,z=x-GunX,y-GunY,z-GunZ x,y,z=rotZ(x,y,z,-EZ) x,y,z=rotY(x,y,z,-EY) x,y,z=rotX(x,y,z,-EX) x,y,z=x,y,z-0.25 yaw,pitch=AT(x,y),AT(z/(x^2+y^2)^0.5) return yaw,pitch end function rotX(x,y,z,EX) x,y,z=x,y*cos(-EX)-z*sin(-EX),y*sin(-EX)+z*cos(-EX) return x,y,z end function rotY(x,y,z,EY) x,y,z=x*cos(-EY)-y*sin(-EY),x*sin(-EY)+y*cos(-EY),z return x,y,z end function rotZ(x,y,z,EZ) x,y,z=x*cos(EZ)-z*sin(EZ),y,x*sin(EZ)+z*cos(EZ) return x,y,z end function D3(x,y,z) return (x*x+y*y+z*z)^0.5 end function Dot3(x,y,z,a,b,c) return x*a+y*b+z*c end function getY(v,t) return -g*t/drag+(g/drag+v)*(1-m.exp(-drag*t))/drag end function getTime(v,x) return -m.log(1-drag*x/v)/drag end function calc(D,E) local t,a,w,h=0,E,D*cos(E),D*sin(E) for i=1,10 do local vx,vy=vel*cos(a),vel*sin(a) t=getTime(vx,w) if t>lifeSpan then a=E return a,t,false end y=getY(vy,t) if y>=h-error then return a,t,true end
a=a+E-atan(y,w) end a=E return a,t,false end function clamp(a,mn,mx) tf=false if a>=mn and a<=mx then tf=true end return m.min(m.max(a,mn),mx),tf end function CLMP(a,b) return m.min(m.max(a,-b),b) end
